verdict.rationale: Brave's LLM Context endpoint returns pre-extracted page content rather than short snippets, with configurable token and URL limits, which is the product's own capability for going beyond snippets. However, the content is token-budgeted and relevance-thresholded, and nothing documents full, untruncated page text or a markdown output format; the Web Search 'extra snippets' feature only adds up to 5 excerpts per result. Missing for 10: evidence of full-page (untruncated) text retrieval, a markdown output format, documentation of the response content structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve full page text or markdown for results, not just snippets

citations.quote: Pre-extracted page content for your LLM — no scraping, token-budgeted.
Advanced Web search, with pre-extracted content that's optimized for AI agents, LLM grounding, and RAG pipelines.
Fine-tune the amount of context with configurable token and URL limits
The extra snippets feature provides up to 5 additional excerpts per search result, giving you more context from each web page.
